explanation: Golf was played at Paris 1900 and St. Louis 1904, then vanished for 112 years. It returned at Rio 2016, the same Games at which rugby sevens made its debut.

claims.text: Golf was first played at the Olympics at the 1900 Paris Games.
Rugby sevens made its Olympic debut at the 2016 Rio de Janeiro Games.
Golf was also played at the 1904 St. Louis Olympics, then left the programme until Rio 2016, 112 years later.
